item.title: Bridgeport Fire Department to hire 6 new employees
item.description: In the first six months, the city has raised nearly half of the projected total of $600,000 in fees. The city has expressed concerns about needing more emergency service employees as calls have become more consistent in Bridgeport.

item.title: West Virginia companies apply to build new natural gas plant in Monongalia County
item.description: An email from the Public Service Commission states that the two companies are seeking approval to build a 1,200-megawatt (MW) combined cycle natural gas plant, which as proposed would cost $2.84 billion and would be built at the Fort Martin Power Station in Monongalia County.

item.title: Meadowbrook Mall hosts card show on Valentines Day weekend
item.description: Football, basketball, baseball, Pokémon and other kinds of cards were available to guests visiting the mall. Vendors were spread out displaying what they had to offer.

item.title: The Wonder Bar celebrates 80 year anniversary
item.description: The decor of the restaurant honors its historic past with many old pictures and memorabilia on the walls. In its outside section, an overlook view of Clarksburg is there for guests to experience.

item.title: West Virginia Botanic Garden hosts Great Backyard Bird Count Event
item.description: The Great Backyard Bird Count is an international initiative founded by the Cornell Lab of Ornithology and the National Audubon Society. The program encourages bird watchers of all experience levels to observe and report bird sightings, helping scientists better understand bird behavior, distribution and long-term population trends.

item.title: Chestnut Ridge Park hosts Valentine’s Day celebration
item.description: The park hosted its “Valentine’s Fireside Fest” at the warming hut, offering guests an opportunity to take a break from outdoor recreation and enjoy complimentary hot cocoa and cookies by the fire. In addition to refreshments, attendees of all ages participated in a Valentine’s Day card-making activity available throughout the day.

item.title: Doddridge County couple charged after 2 kids found in 'extreme deplorable living conditions'
item.description: A pair has been arrested and is facing charges after deputies with the Doddridge County Sheriff's Department say children in their care were found living in "extreme deplorable living conditions."

item.title: 2 charged after victim shot 5 times in Randolph County: WVSP
item.description: Two men have been arrested and are facing charges in Randolph County after troopers with the West Virginia State Police say a man was shot five times.

item.title: Student arrested after allegedly air dropping shooters list at Buckhannon-Upshur Middle School
item.description: Buckhannon-Upshur Middle School was placed on lockdown on Friday and a student is in custody after they allegedly distributed a shooter's list to other students.

item.title: Hiker rescued in Pendleton County after sliding off trail, down 'steep terrain'
item.description: According to a Facebook post by the Pendleton County Office of Emergency Management, the incident took place at around 6:17 p.m. on Friday on the High Knob Trail near the West Virginia, Virginia state line.
